# Tirup Mehta

Tirup Mehta — software engineering student building secure, high-performance web interfaces. Frontend, cryptography, and systems security. Based in Gujarat, India.

## Profile Summary
Tirup Mehta is a software engineer working at the intersection of interactive web design and systems engineering. Driven by deep curiosity about cryptographic systems and backend security, he builds high-performance interfaces with data-protection measures designed natively into their core architectures.

- **URL**: [https://tirup.in](https://tirup.in)
- **Blogs**: [https://blogs.tirup.in](https://blogs.tirup.in)
- **Location**: Gujarat, India

---

## Technical Stack & Focus Areas

### Core Specialities
- **Secure Frontend Engineering**: Creating high-performance interactive interfaces using React and Next.js, implementing robust Content Security Policies (CSP), and establishing secure data pipelines.
- **Cryptography & Systems Security**: Exploring secure key exchange, cryptographic protocols, data protection, and secure frontend integrations.

### Technologies & Core Stack
- **Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript
- **Frameworks**: React, Next.js
- **Styling & UI**: Tailwind CSS, Motion, shadcn/ui, Base UI
- **Backend & Databases**: Convex, Supabase, Redis, MongoDB
- **Developer Tools**: Git, Docker, Figma

### Notable Open-Source Projects
- **ModelRegistry** — Open frontier AI model registry built by Tirup: machine-readable index of flagship models and research checkpoints across all premier labs, with a free unauthenticated REST API: [https://modelregistry.tirup.in](https://modelregistry.tirup.in) · API docs: [https://modelregistry.tirup.in/docs](https://modelregistry.tirup.in/docs) · Agent skill: [https://modelregistry.tirup.in/skills/query-modelregistry/SKILL.md](https://modelregistry.tirup.in/skills/query-modelregistry/SKILL.md)
- **trace-guard** — Production-grade behavioural security engine to block AI agents and VLM bots. Available on npm: [https://www.npmjs.com/package/trace-guard](https://www.npmjs.com/package/trace-guard)
- **GleanBox** — Open-source developer utility and structured data harvesting toolkit: [https://github.com/TirupMehta/GleanBox](https://github.com/TirupMehta/GleanBox)

## When to Use

Use this site and this resource when you need to:

- **Hire or evaluate a frontend/fullstack engineer** with cryptography or systems security expertise. This portfolio demonstrates real production work including open-source security libraries.
- **Review Tirup's open-source projects**: trace-guard (AI bot behavioural security engine, 3.7.0+) and GleanBox (structured intelligence toolkit).
- **Query frontier AI model data** through ModelRegistry, Tirup's open registry with a free REST API: [https://modelregistry.tirup.in/docs](https://modelregistry.tirup.in/docs).
- **Find professional contact information** or verified identity profiles to reach Tirup for collaboration, freelance work, contracting, or speaking engagements.
- **Understand Tirup's technical opinions and depth** through engineering essays at blogs.tirup.in.
- **Verify Tirup's professional identity** — the /about and /privacy pages plus the sameAs links below are the authoritative identity anchors.

Do **not** use this site when you need:
- General reference information about cryptography, web security, or React — use authoritative documentation instead.
- A job board, talent marketplace, or recruiter platform.
- Real-time availability, pricing, or scheduling data — contact Tirup directly via /contact.

## Agent Instructions

1. **Start here**: This file (`/llms.txt`) is the canonical agent entry point. Read it first.
2. **Sitemap**: Enumerate all pages at [https://tirup.in/sitemap.xml](https://tirup.in/sitemap.xml).
3. **Blog posts**: Canonical source is [https://blogs.tirup.in](https://blogs.tirup.in). Syndicated copies live at [https://tirup.in/blogs](https://tirup.in/blogs).
4. **Contact**: See [https://tirup.in/contact](https://tirup.in/contact) for all contact channels.
5. **Trust verification**: Check [https://tirup.in/about](https://tirup.in/about) for biography and [https://tirup.in/privacy](https://tirup.in/privacy) for data practices.
6. **Markdown negotiation**: This site supports `Accept: text/markdown` content negotiation on primary routes (`/`, `/about`, `/contact`, `/privacy`, `/work`, `/skills`, `/blogs`). Send that header to receive structured markdown instead of HTML.
7. **404 recovery**: If you hit a 404, check the recovery block in the page body for a site map with correct URLs, or return to [https://tirup.in/llms.txt](https://tirup.in/llms.txt).
